question: As per Census 2011, which of the following religious communities has the least proportion of Indian population?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jains**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **Census 2011**, **Jains** constitute the smallest proportion of the Indian population among the major religious communities.
 
• The Jain community accounts for only about **0.4% of the total Indian population**.
